No battle records yet.
Both players run simultaneously with the same seed (same map and coin layout). Score = distance score (scroll distance / 3) + coin score (gold 50 - 5 x level, silver 5, bonus 100 + 20 x level). When a player dies, their score is locked at that point; when the time limit ends, the surviving player is also compared using their score at that point. TIER 1 ~ 10 are ordered from weaker to stronger models. Set LEFT to HUMAN to play directly, using click / touch / spacebar.

INFO
REMAKE + PPO AGENT

This page

This is a remake of the Flash game 고군분투.swf (ActionScript 2), rebuilt directly from its decompiled logic. Physics, collision boxes, level maps, coin layouts, and level-up rules were taken from the bytecode, while the graphics reproduce the shapes, bitmaps, and timelines from the SWF.

Controls (HUMAN mode)

  • While running, click the screen (or touch, spacebar): jump.
  • Click again in the air: fire the plunger rope. It hooks when it reaches the top of a tower.
  • While swinging, hold to pull yourself up and release to drop. When the swing ends, you launch with a spin jump.

Agent

An MLP with 64 inputs, 2 hidden layers (tanh), and 1 output logit decides each frame whether to press the mouse button. It is trained with PPO; rewards are +0.02 per survival frame, +2 for a clear, and 0 for death. The starting level, progress, and scroll phase are randomized; levels with frequent deaths are sampled more often, and states immediately before death can optionally be replayed for training.

Inputs include character state, rope state, 6 visible blocks, remaining ground time, and forward-looking features calculated from the game rules (whether firing the rope now will hook a tower, and where the character will land after jumping or falling). No information outside the screen is used. All 64 inputs can be viewed in NETWORK > INPUTS.

ItemValue
Blocks150 px. 1 hole, 2 ground, 3 rope tower, 4 finish
JumpInitial speed 30, gravity 3.5, fall limit 20
Rope+45 / -35 px per frame, hooks the top of towers, spin initial speed 45, gravity 5.25
Level50 / 100 / 150 / 200 / 250 / 300 blocks, speeds 15 18 21 23 25 27 px/frame
ClearCleared when the finish block appears (about 6,950 frames, 232 seconds)

Training in the browser

Press START FROM SCRATCH in the TRAIN tab to start from random weights. Each Web Worker has a copy of the game to calculate PPO gradients, and the page averages them and updates with Adam. Speed is almost proportional to the number of CPU cores, so increase WORKERS. In single-core measurements with 64 hidden units, 77% of full games were cleared after about 1.75 million frames (12 minutes). The pretrained model was trained offline (C simulator + numpy) for about 98.3 million frames and clears about 99% of full games. CONTINUE PRETRAINED continues training from those weights.

Limitations

  • Because there is no real Flash Player, the processing order within a tick and hitTest boundaries are estimated. They may differ from the original SWF by about one frame.
  • The map sequence differs from the original because Flash random numbers are different, but the map appearance probabilities are the same.
  • There is no sound, ranking, or server functionality. The graphics are copyrighted by the original creator (NHN), so use this for personal learning only.
